content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Odisha University of Agriculture & Technology (OUAT). OUAT is a prominent educational institution in Odisha, focusing on agricultural and veterinary sciences, offering various academic and research opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Guest Faculty. These positions are typically on a contractual basis, providing teaching and academic support in specialized fields within the university.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions. These openings are distributed across different specialized areas within the veterinary science department, as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly at the specified venue on the scheduled date and time with all necessary documents for registration and interview.

faq.question: Q5. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 09 October 2026. Candidates are advised to arrive at the venue by 10:30 AM to complete all registration formalities before the interview commences.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Guest Faculty posts is 64 years as on 01.10.2026. This age criterion ensures experienced professionals can contribute to the university's academic environment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required for Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master Degree in Vety. Medicine or Vety. Surgery from a recognized university, with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. Good academic records are also essential for these teaching roles.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The salary for Guest Faculty is Rs. 1,200 per class, subject to a maximum of 50 classes, totaling up to Rs. 60,000 per month. This compensation structure is designed to attract qualified professionals.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Yes, all candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500.00. This fee must be submitted as a Demand Draft or Bankers Cheque in favor of Comptroller, OUAT, Bhubaneswar, before the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, two sets of self-attested photocopies, two passport-size photographs, and an updated Bio-data. An NOC from the current employer is also required.
